name: Noodle bowl salad
assumptions: Recipe serves 2 based on typical noodle bowl portions with 125g dry noodles and 150g salmon total (standard for 2 adult servings).
Preparation time estimated at 15 minutes: 4 min soak/drain plus ~10 min for chopping, mixing dressing, and assembly; no cooking required.
'Ground Nut Oil' classified as peanut oil, triggering peanuts allergen.
'Hot Smoked Flaked Salmon' confirms fish and pescatarian compatibility; no dairy, eggs, or tree nuts present.
All ingredients screened conservatively per listed items; no substitutions.
instructions:
step 1
Drop the noodles into a large bowl, then pour over enough boiling water to cover. Tip in the sliced sugar snaps and leave for 4 minutes. Drain in a colander, put under cold running water to cool off, then drain again. Tip into a bowl and toss in the sesame oil.

step 2
Mix the dressing ingredients. Pile spring onions, coriander and salmon onto the noodles, pour over the dressing and toss everything together. Serve with a pretzel or bread roll.
